scenes.title: 01 / The document CLI
scenes.caption: Real command execution in synthetic Git projects. This browser is a CLI review harness, not a product GUI.

commands.stdout:
factoryctl — inspect and safely edit Markdown knowledge bundles

Global flags (before or after commands):
  --path DIR --project ID --checkout TOKEN --json --non-interactive

Commands:
  projects list
  init --project-id ID [--starter software]
  records list [--type TYPE] [--query TEXT] [--limit N] [--cursor C]
  records show PATH
  records create --type TYPE --slug SLUG [--input KEY=VALUE ...]
  records update PATH --expected-revision HASH --set KEY=VALUE ...
  records replace PATH --expected-revision HASH --file FILE  (- reads stdin)
  records delete PATH --expected-revision HASH
  validate [--level okf|factory] [--require-complete-links]
  templates diff
  actions list --record PATH
  doctor

All input is explicit; this milestone never prompts or starts an agent.
GUI, MCP, agent actions, network link checks and asset export are unsupported.
Example: factoryctl --path . records list --type Task --json

assertions: Runtime explicitly unsupported; no Git subprocesses

scenes.title: 03 / Discover and create
scenes.caption: Discovery reports project identity. Explicit template inputs create a Task and revision.

commands.command: factoryctl --path /tmp/factoryctl-review-a6aekG/S1 records create --type Task --slug launch --input "title=Launch review" --input "summary=Real CLI evidence." --json

scenes.title: 04 / Explicit input, exclusive creation
scenes.caption: Missing input never prompts. An existing destination is protected.

commands.command: factoryctl --path /tmp/factoryctl-review-a6aekG/S1 records create --type Task --slug launch --input title=Duplicate --input "summary=No overwrite" --json

scenes.title: 05 / Find a record • filter and paginate
scenes.caption: Lists support type, case-insensitive search, bounded pages and snapshot cursors.

scenes.title: 06 / Read exact source and revision
scenes.caption: Read includes exact Markdown, parsed metadata, links, backlinks and the SHA-256 revision.

scenes.title: 07 / Safe field edit
scenes.caption: A valid enum update preserves unrelated source bytes. Structural validity is not workflow approval.

scenes.title: 08 / Conflict and invalid-state recovery
scenes.caption: Stale revision, invalid enum and expired cursor produce explicit errors; rejected writes preserve bytes.

scenes.title: 09 / Whole-document replacement
scenes.caption: Replace from stdin supports deliberate body edits using the latest revision.

scenes.title: 10 / Incoming links guard deletion
scenes.caption: A dependent Task creates a backlink. Deletion is refused until the incoming record is removed.

commands.command: factoryctl --path /tmp/factoryctl-review-a6aekG/S1 records create --type Task --slug dependent --input title=Dependent --input summary=[Launch](launch.md#evidence) --json

scenes.title: 11 / Templates and available actions
scenes.caption: Inspect local defaults and discover prompt applicability without launching an agent.
